tools.name: calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event on a named calendar. Use this when the caller supplies a specific time. If the caller wants the system to pick a time, use calendar_propose_slots instead.

calendar_id.description: Calendar to write to, from calendar_list.

tools.name: calendar_propose_slots
tools.description: Propose open time slots for a set of attendees. Use this when no time has been chosen yet. Do not use it to write an event; that is calendar_create_event.

tools.name: calendar_list
tools.description: List calendars the caller can write to. Use this first when a calendar id is needed; it is not for reading events, which is calendar_list_events.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
